system: English common law and local statutes

constitution.history: previous 1985; latest entered into force 1 January 2009 (The Falkland Islands Constitution Order 2008)

courts.highest: Court of Appeal (consists of the court president, the chief justice as an ex officio non-resident member, and 2 justices of appeal); Supreme Court (consists of the chief justice)
courts.judges: chief justice, court of appeal president, and justices appointed by the governor; tenure specified in each justice's instrument of appointment
courts.lower: Magistrate's Court (senior magistrate presides over civil and criminal divisions); Court of Summary Jurisdiction
courts.note: appeals beyond the Court of Appeal are referred to the Judicial Committee of the Privy Council (in London)
